captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. The colored series correspond to the probe |eta| bins: 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.768; The resulting scale factor is 0.8415 +/- 0.0211.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.247; The resulting scale factor is 0.8339 +/- 0.0136.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.136; The resulting scale factor is 0.9915 +/- 0.0335.
captions.mass_fit_bin_03: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.092; The resulting scale factor is 0.9186 +/- 0.0335.
captions.mass_fit_bin_04: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.156; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.mass_fit_bin_05: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=0.881; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties; bins without a valid fit are omitted. The marker series correspond to the probe |eta| bins listed in the legend.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
